title: remix URL does not get updated
body: > Hi @Haroenv, thanks for your quick response, we solved the error follow your reply! > > Now we have another issue, when we change the refinements, the url changed, but the `loader` of remix not `reload` > > It makes me upset because we need to do some data transformation work on the `loader` according to the url. > > You can visit this sandbox: https://codesandbox.io/p/sandbox/wizardly-monad-g3s9ny?file=/app/components/Search.tsx:1,1 > > When you select one refinement, the url on the address bar changed, but not trigger the `reload` of remix loader > > > > *Originally posted by @jason-rb2 in https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch/issues/5831#issuecomment-1706112993*
